# Security Policy

I take security vulnerabilities seriously. Please do not open a public issue
for a suspected vulnerability.

- Use **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability** in this repository so
  the report stays private. If that form is unavailable, email
  `hi@santi020k.com`.
- Include a description, reproduction steps, affected URLs or revisions, and
  any suggested mitigation.
- Do not include real credentials, personal data, or destructive proof of
  concept payloads.
- I will acknowledge a complete report as soon as practical and coordinate a
  fix and disclosure timeline with the reporter.

The latest production version at `https://santi020k.com` is supported. Older
deployments and forks are not maintained.
